Where the workload lives changes the architecture

Four markets, four delivery patterns — and one team behind all of them.

Egypt — hybrid operation and continuity

Most Egyptian organisations do not move in one step. We design hybrid patterns that link the local data centre to AWS, then migrate in waves while business continuity and branch connectivity stay intact.

  1. 01 VMware exit and data-centre migration
  2. 02 Disaster recovery with agreed RTO and RPO
  3. 03 SAP, ERP and business-application workloads
  4. 04 Operations and support in Arabic

Always on

Roaya's Advanced Tier Services Partner status reflects demonstrated AWS expertise and delivery capability. For customers, that means access to certified specialists and a local team that can assess, migrate, secure and operate AWS environments end to end.

It depends on the workload and the regulatory requirement. We design hybrid patterns that keep sensitive data local while the rest of the platform runs on AWS, and we validate Region availability and residency requirements against official AWS information before committing to anything.

MAP is an AWS programme that supports planned migrations. We help eligible customers identify and navigate the AWS programmes; availability, eligibility and terms vary and are determined by AWS. We run the eligibility check during the proposal stage.

The assessment gives you a specific timeline for your estate. In practice we migrate in successive waves, so each group of workloads moves once it has been tested rather than in one large cutover.

AWS bills on consumption. We start with tagging, budgets and reporting so you can see where spend goes, then work on rightsizing, commitments and architecture patterns. The result depends on your environment and we discuss it after the assessment.

Yes. Delivery, documentation and support are available in Arabic and English, with teams working on regional hours and a single escalation path agreed up front.
